body:
m1 owner review of 80af255 (strands; fresh-context adversarial pass on a clean worktree at the SHA, pin 0329c43): BLOCK - one correctness bug on the real induction path plus the chief's REQUIRED coverage item confirmed unaddressed. Gate itself is green (counts below). Consolidates with the chief's ACCEPT-WITH-NITS; the chief's (1) and my (2) are the same item.

REQUIRED (1) threshold asymmetry, Scoring.scala:378-379. unitHas classes a unit as other/semantic/repetition if ANY atom carries ANY mass > 0.0 on that address, while target needs >= 0.5 (:376, :430). Synthetic: one atom {Target 0.9, OtherSpecific 0.1} -> purity Observed(0.5), otherEventDrift Observed(1.0); {Target 0.9, GeneralKnowledge 0.1} -> semanticization 1.0; {Target 0.9, Repetition 0.1} -> redundancy 1.0. Production path: induce.scala:333-337 puts 0.3*(1-targetMass) = 0.045 OtherSpecific mass on EVERY target-cluster atom whenever alternatives is non-empty (induce.scala:293-296: a competing episode cluster within alternativeMargin 0.25). So purity collapses to <= 0.5 and drift to ~1.0 exactly in the drift condition the strand is meant to detect. Not triggered on the Birthday fixture, which induces no alternative (addresses Target 0.89 / Unresolved 0.11; 0 of 13 target units also counted other; purity 0.929, drift 0.056) - which is why "purity strictly between 0 and 1" passes. Minimal fix: one classification rule per atom - unitHas tests massAt(pred) >= 0.5 (or pred(a.address.mode)) - plus a mixed-distribution test and a test on an induced model WITH an alternative episode.

REQUIRED (2) coverage (chief's #1), confirmed: only phenomenology carries Coverage. Bare ScoreEstimate with no Coverage: densityPerWord/PerSecond (:477-478), purity (:479), integration (:463), fragmentation (:464-470), semanticization/drift/redundancy (:485-487), probeGain (:281-283). participantUnits reaches only phenomenology (:490); massCoverage (:180) is atom-level and does not describe the unit rates (an atom with Missing count mass still counts as a target unit, density 0.1, while massCoverage = Coverage(1,0)). Scaladoc :398 "participantUnits is coverage-eligible for the unit rates" is false. Minimal fix: unitCoverage = Coverage.of(participantUnits, assessed) on Profile, situation rates eligible = |target situations|; correct :398.

NITS: (3) :384-386 grainKeys mixes situation-id and unit-id strings in one Set; one unit, one situation, three visual atoms (two Segment-content) -> perceptualProfile Visual = 2.0, contradicting the "1 per situation" doc at :246. (4) :480 anchoring is a bare count (0.0 on empty, not Missing) and one target TemporalFact.Relation anchors both endpoints (2.0 from a single "before" atom). (5) :272 ratio passes NaN through (seconds = NaN -> Observed(NaN)); unreachable via the model path but the 5-arg profile is public. (6) unit-OR semantics overstate probeGain and redundancy: a post-probe unit with 1 target + 4 repetition atoms counts as a full new unit (design record 65.6 says "new" excludes repeats); a unit with 1 target + 1 repetition atom is both a target unit and a redundant unit (redundancy 1.0); induce.scala:304-322 assigns Repetition per whole unit so the pipeline avoids this but the public API does not - document. (7) AI mapping: semanticization = PersonalKnowledge | GeneralKnowledge | RepeatedOrCategoric follows 65.2, but the traditional Levine sheet maps RepeatedOrCategoric to ExternalEvent (:137-139), not ExternalSemantic - say so; Extended scope lands in neither drift nor semanticization (pre-existing). (8) evidence - every strand is a bare Double/ScoreEstimate with no contributing unit/situation ids, so "which words support purity = 0.5" needs a re-run of the grouping; the vision asks that each score stay examinable - expose at least the counts (assessed, targetUnits, otherUnits, targetSituations), ideally the unit ids, in a follow-up.

VERIFIED OK: atomization invariance (suite + probes); order invariance - full Profile equality over 4 permutations of a 3-component graph; duplicate situations collapse; MentalStateFact has no situation field (enforced by the type, not assumed); fragmentation: single situation Observed(0.0), no target situation Missing, Unresolved relation atoms ignored, orphan relation endpoints become nodes (integ 0.5 / frag 0.5, consistent); empty -> Missing for density/purity/probeGain/frag/integ; only-external -> purity Missing, drift Observed(0), semanticization 1.0; only-other -> purity Observed(0.0); words = 0 / seconds = 0 -> Missing; targetMass is the raw mass sum and no rate reads it; 2-arg bridge - compiling ProfileScoring.phenomenology(Vector.empty, None) from another package fails with "missing argument for parameter participantUnits", nothing leaks it. Birthday: purity 0.929, frag 0.786, integ 0.214, probeGain 0.538, anchoring 7, phenomenology coverage 18/18.

COUNTS at 80af255: interviewJVM Passed: Total 39, Failed 0; interviewJS Passed: Total 39, Failed 0; fixturesJVM Passed: Total 96, Failed 0; scalafmtCheckAll success; interviewNative running, count to follow. Note for all sessions: a first sbt load died with NoClassDefFoundError in ~/.sbt/1.0/staging/.../gale/build.sbt (stale staging class via grakern's transitive ProjectRef; retry loaded cleanly) - a shared-staging race.
